security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A native window onto your Companion Planning server
bundle.longDescription: Companion Planning in its own window. It shows the web app of a server you run, so sign-in, live updates and everything else behave as they do in a browser.
